note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SLN 10-15; A06b SLN 10-15; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Slovenia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Slovenia for 10 years, of which 5 were continuous, and with a 'settled status' immediately before the application. ... Evidence of renunciation of citizenship of another country (unless the person is stateless or when renunciation is legally impossible or unreasonable) required. Renunciation is not required for nationals of EU Member States if reciprocity applies. ... n.a.
